# dns

Cluster DNS operand configuration

```yaml
stack:
  dns:
    enabled: true
```

## Settings

Under `stack.dns.config`. Maps merge across layers; lists are replaced whole.

| Key | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `tolerations` | Tolerations for the DNS daemonset. The default tolerates every taint so that workloads on infra, storage and master nodes keep cluster DNS. | `[{operator: Exists}]` |

## Policies

`<cluster>` is the ManagedCluster name, or hubName on the hub. `global.remediationAction: inform` overrides every action below.

Standards: NIST SP 800-53. Controls: CM-2 Baseline Configuration. Categories: CM Configuration Management.

### Policy `config`

`config-dns-<cluster>`: Cluster DNS node placement.

| Template | Action | Renders | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `config-tolerations` | enforce | [dns-tolerations](converters/dns-tolerations.yaml) | DNS daemonset tolerations |
